name: layout_areas
description: One area of a layout: its rectangle in canvas units, stacking order, appearance, audio and kind, and for catalog areas the view's settings.
lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save, keeping each area's key; deleted with the layout.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated area UUID, new on every save.
Company that owns the layout (tenant key).
Layout the area belongs to.
Stable area key chosen by the editor, unique in the layout; program outputs refer to it.
Display name of the area, trimmed, 1 to 40 characters.
Left edge.
Top edge.
Width, at least 40 and inside the canvas.
Height, at least 40 and inside the canvas.
Stacking order, 0 to 99 and unique in the layout; higher draws above.
Background color as #RRGGBB.
How media fills the area: contain (whole, letterboxed) or cover (cropped, never distorted).
Whether the area plays without sound; new areas start muted.
Volume from 0 to 100 when not muted.
MEDIA (plays what its program output selects) or CATALOG (shows a catalog view).
Whether the area changes content with the layout's pages.
Catalog the view shows.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a media area.

columns.Meaning: View presentation: list, table, menu or agenda.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a media area.

columns.Meaning: View text size, 24 to 200; text never shrinks below it.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a media area.

columns.Meaning: Whether the view shows unavailable records as unavailable instead of hiding them.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a media area.

columns.Meaning: Seconds each view page shows when the area is not page-controlled, 5 to 120.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a media area.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The viewed catalog belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while a layout shows it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, layout_id) REFERENCES layouts(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The layout belongs to the same company; areas are deleted with it.
Media fit is contain or cover.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((x >= 0) AND (y >= 0) AND (width >= 40) AND (height >= 40) AND ((x + width) <= 1920) AND ((y + height) <= 1920)))
constraints.Purpose: Rectangles are at least 40 units and within the larger canvas dimension; the API checks the layout's own canvas.
Names are trimmed and not empty.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'CATALOG'::"LayoutAreaKind") = (catalog_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind = 'CATALOG'::"LayoutAreaKind") = (presentation IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind = 'CATALOG'::"LayoutAreaKind") = (text_size IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind = 'CATALOG'::"LayoutAreaKind") = (show_unavailable IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind = 'CATALOG'::"LayoutAreaKind") = (page_seconds IS NOT NULL)) AND ((presentation IS NULL) OR ((presentation)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['list'::character varying, 'table'::character varying, 'menu'::character varying, 'agenda'::character varying])::text[]))) AND ((text_size IS NULL) OR ((text_size >= 24) AND (text_size <= 200))) AND ((page_seconds IS NULL) OR ((page_seconds >= 5) AND (page_seconds <= 120)))))
constraints.Purpose: Catalog areas, and only they, carry a complete view with a known presentation and bounded text size and paging.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX layout_areas_catalog_idx ON public.layout_areas USING btree (company_id, catalog_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the layouts that show a catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layout_areas_company_id_id_key ON public.layout_areas USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that view fields and page contents reference.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layout_areas_key_key ON public.layout_areas USING btree (company_id, layout_id, key)
constraints.Purpose: Area keys are unique within a layout.
